description: PatSnap Open Platform capability registry. Documents every endpoint, its purpose, input/output, batch limits, cost behavior, authentication, status, and error codes.
governance_rules: LLM-generated patent facts are hypotheses. Retrieved patent text is evidence.
Keyword presence is discovery evidence, never claim evidence.
Three separate counts: keyword_match_count, claim_relevant_count, claim_limitations_disclosed_count.
PatSnap similarity is discovery evidence, not anticipation evidence.
Never use abandonment as evidence that technical disclosure is irrelevant.
Three graphs: technology (who discloses), ownership (who owns), buyer (who wants). Never merge.
Every conclusion must point to evidence_id → primary source. If chain breaks: CONCLUSION = UNSUPPORTED.
Cost optimization: COUNT → DISCOVERY → SEMANTIC RANKING → FAMILY COLLAPSE → RELEVANCE → CLAIMS → DEEP EVIDENCE. Never retrieve claims for thousands of patents.

P018_claim_data.output: claims[], claim_text, claim_count, claim_independent_count, patent_id, pn
P018_claim_data.notes: Primary evidence source for 102/103 analysis. Returns HTML claim text that must be parsed.

P003_analytics_query.purpose: Search patents with structured query, return count
P003_analytics_query.input: query_text (TACD: prefix, PA:, IN:, CPC:, IPC:, etc.), collapse_by, collapse_type, collapse_order
P003_analytics_query.notes: Returns COUNT only, not patent IDs. Use for discovery funnel: COUNT → filter → then use nested-search or current-assignee for IDs.

P005_current_assignee_search.purpose: Search patents by current assignee — returns patent IDs and metadata
P005_current_assignee_search.output: patent_number, patent_id, current_assignee, original_assignee, title, inventor, publication_date, application_date, total_result_count

error_codes.68300004: Invalid parameter — needs different parameter format

P005_current_assignee_search.notes: CRITICAL: this is the proper way to build company corpus. Has not been tested with current API key. PA: field in query-search-count returns 0 for CereVasc — this endpoint may work differently.

P007_similar_search_patent.purpose: Find patents similar to a given patent number

AI30_similar_patent_comparison.purpose: Semantic similar patent search using technical means + technical effects description
AI30_similar_patent_comparison.output: similar patents with relevance scores and relevant passages from claims/descriptions
AI30_similar_patent_comparison.notes: Previously returned 67200203 'API need a true rate'. Requires higher API tier. This is the MOST IMPORTANT endpoint for semantic hostile search.

nested_search_patent.purpose: Search patents and return patent IDs (not just count)
nested_search_patent.fallback: current-assignee search or web search for patent IDs
nested_search_patent.notes: Returns patent IDs for some queries but returns 0 results for others despite query-search-count showing results. Behavior inconsistent. May require different query syntax.

P012_bibliography.purpose: Retrieve patent bibliography (title, assignee, inventors, dates, CPC, IPC, family)
P012_bibliography.output: title, applicant, original_assignee, current_assignee, priority_date, application_date, publication_date, legal_status, family_id, inventors, CPC, IPC
P012_bibliography.notes: Critical for ownership graph and family reconstruction. Has not been tested.

P013_legal_status.purpose: Retrieve patent legal status (granted, abandoned, expired, pending, etc.)
P013_legal_status.notes: Important for distinguishing active vs abandoned vs expired prior art.

P015_cited_by.output: citing_patent, cited_patent, citation_type (examiner/applicant/other), citation_category (X/Y/A), country, organization
P015_cited_by.notes: Critical for citation-neighborhood expansion. Has not been tested.

P045_description_translated.purpose: Retrieve patent description (full text, translated to English)

error_codes.10001: Required parameter lang not present — try lang=en

P045_description_translated.notes: Important for understanding mechanism, technical effect, motivation, teaching away.

P073_description_offset.purpose: Retrieve description section offsets for navigation
P073_description_offset.notes: Allows locating specific passages in the description rather than treating as undifferentiated blob.

P101_claim_parser.purpose: Parse claims into technical features, limitations, claim structure
P101_claim_parser.output: independent/dependent claims, claim type, technical features, limitations, claim hierarchy
P101_claim_parser.notes: Requires higher API tier. Should be used as independent decomposition oracle, not replacing our canonical resolver.

R025_enterprise_core_patent.purpose: Identify core patents for a company
R025_enterprise_core_patent.output: patent_value, legal_value, market_value, legal_status, events, invention_title
R025_enterprise_core_patent.notes: Company-level intelligence. Identifies which patents PatSnap considers most valuable.

A108_largest_patent_family.purpose: Identify largest invention families for a company
A108_largest_patent_family.notes: Company-level intelligence. Identifies strategically important families.

P034_litigation.output: case, court, plaintiff, defendant, filing_date, verdict_date, region, judges
P034_litigation.notes: Important for strategic assessment. Litigated patents have different risk profiles.

capability_summary.critical_gap: Semantic search (AI30), bibliography (P012), claim parser (P101), and company intelligence (R025) require higher API tier. P005 assignee search needs parameter fix. P045 and A108 need lang parameter.
available_capabilities: P018 claim-data — patent claim text (primary evidence)
P007 similar-search-patent — patent similarity search (20 results)

cost_policy.principle: COUNT → DISCOVERY → SEMANTIC RANKING → FAMILY COLLAPSE → RELEVANCE → CLAIMS → DEEP EVIDENCE
rules: Never retrieve claims for thousands of patents
Use query-search-count first to assess result volume
Use family collapse (DOCDB/INPADOC/EXTEND) to reduce duplicates
Batch claim retrieval (up to 100 per request)
Reserve description retrieval for top candidates only
Semantic search is per-call (1 query, up to 20 results) — use sparingly with well-crafted technical descriptions

provenance_policy.rule: Every evidence item must trace to: source → patent_number → patent_id → family_id → claim_number/paragraph → exact_passage → content_hash → retrieval_timestamp
provenance_policy.llm_assertion_rule: LLM-generated patent facts are hypotheses. Retrieved patent text is evidence. If LLM asserts 'Patent X teaches Y' but retrieved claims do not support Y: HALLUCINATION_DETECTED. Automatically reject, record contradiction, preserve event permanently.
